description: List every folder and page in a workspace's company brain, nested, with each page's id. This is the wiki's table of contents and the only place page ids come from — read it before deciding a subject is missing, because most material belongs on a page that already exists. Names and paths only: use read_wiki_page for a page's contents.

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug, from any Monnet URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b'). Call list_workspaces if you do not have it.

name: get_wiki_tree
